Published evaluation: 79.20% accuracy on 976 artist-disjoint held-out songs.
How to interpret this

“Artist Score” is 1 only if the normalized artist had a chart event before this song’s reference date. The displayed percentage is the tree’s probability within a deliberately balanced research sample. It does not estimate a song’s commercial-success probability.

Model: final_suite_v1 decision tree · Inputs: tempo, loudness, duration, Artist Score · The app does not upload or retain your values.
HitPredict uses Million Song Dataset descriptors and historical Billboard labels. Exact matching and finite chart history may leave label noise.
